snippet.title: There’s a Hidden Skeleton Inside the Statue of Liberty — and It Was Rusting Away
snippet.description:
Under the Statue of Liberty's copper skin, about 1,800 iron bars designed by Gustave Eiffel hold every fold. Copper and iron in salty harbor air make a battery, so for almost a century the iron was eaten away, until engineers replaced the whole skeleton in stainless steel between 1984 and 1986 without taking her down.

snippet.title: A Dropped Bullet and a Fired Bullet Hit the Ground At The Same Time
snippet.description:
If you drop one bullet and fire another level from the same height at the same instant, which hits the ground first? Joe Rogan asks it, and Neil deGrasse Tyson says most people get it wrong: they drop at the same rate and land together - moving sideways does nothing to how fast you fall. It's a classic physics-class demo: a launcher fires a ball at a stuffed animal held up by an electromagnet; the ball trips a circuit that lets the animal go, both fall the same distance in the same time, and the ball hits it every single time. (In real air there's a tiny difference - MythBusters measured about 0.04 seconds - but the physics is the same.) Clip from the Joe Rogan Experience #919, used for commentary; the 3D animations are original.

snippet.title: Innie or Outie? Your Doctor Didn't Decide 🤔
snippet.description:
Do you blame the doctor for your outie? It wasn't the cut.

Before birth, the umbilical cord connected your belly to your mom. After birth it's clamped and cut, leaving a small stump. The stump has no blood supply, so it dries up and falls off, and what's left heals into a scar: your belly button. Whether it sinks in or pokes out depends on how you heal, not on how the cord was cut. Most people have an innie; only about 1 in 10 have an outie, and some outies are a small umbilical hernia, where tissue pushes through a gap in the belly muscles.

Sources (hospital and health information pages):
Le Bonheur Children's Hospital, "Innies vs. outies": https://lebonheur.org/blogs/practical-parenting/innies-vs-outies

Not medical advice: if a baby's belly button bulges, ask your doctor.

snippet.title: My Thoughts on the Far Fetched Pilot
snippet.description:
Today the latest indie animated pilot came out on youtube, called far fetched. Is it any good? Lets talk about it. 

So far fetched is about an alternative rock band in a spooky town full of monsters. 

During the pilot the band are in the woods until they’re attacked by a creature. As they escape rue has a realistic panic attack, causing kira to transform into a monster temporarily. They run into another monster that is luckily friends with griff. We get a tease of a future character called drain. 

So let’s start off with the things i liked. First up the voice cast is great, there’s a couple amazing actors you’ll recognise like nola klop, jonah scott, edward bosco and kellen goff. 

The animation is fluid and easy on the eyes, it looks good and there’s some nice variety between the designs of the main characters. 

The soundtrack is also quite unique. We hear some instrumentals throughout and they all sound pretty good. 

Unfortunately however i felt a bit let down. 

First up is the pacing. It’s just under 9 minutes long and feels fast, though very little happens. Like the band is chased by 2 monsters and thats it, there’s very little worldbuilding either. The plot in general is hard to follow. 

The character focus was a bit disjointed too, like if you’ve been following the project along since its announcement 7 years ago you’d expect rue and kira to be the main characters. But quinn dominates most of the runtime. They should’ve kept things grounded by introducing rue and kira first, and then the bandmates later. Like the way scott pilgrim did it, rather than oddly juggling the characters around scene by scene. 

And lastly the overall writing fell a bit flat. There weren’t many comedic moments or things that stood out for me. Like it was written by people who worked on a bunch of indie shows, but none of the elements from those projects were brought over here. I was expecting more. 

So what do you think? Have you seen far fetched? Let me know down below.
